scope: Rough comparison of complete busy windows from interrupted V26 predictive and completed V23 native; not same-version causal validation.
time_origin: Each arm's first GPU-monitor sample, in Asia/Shanghai.

h2d_category_semantics.predictive: JOIN/tool tagged transfer payload; actual pre-boundary start and next-request reuse require separate lifecycle evidence.
h2d_category_semantics.execution_handoff: Submitted-request demand restoration; not anticipatory JOIN/tool prefetch.
h2d_category_semantics.stream_elapsed: Cumulative physical transfer-stream timing; not exposed critical-path waiting or removable JCT.

body_progress_decision: Median absolute token error improves on development inputs, but both models have zero 0-500ms hits in the 500ms trigger replay. Retain evidence and the frozen V7 model.
next_comparison: Complete frozen V27 predictive followed by same-version cold native.
